question.problem:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$5$** | **$9$** | **$15$** | **$22$** | **$28$** |
| $y$ | $-10$ | $-3$ | $5$ | $14$ | $24$ |

 

The vector of coefficients of the plane $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}$ that best fits the data above can be found using multiple linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the observation vector $y$ in this context?
question.worked_solution:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$5$** | **$9$** | **$15$** | **$22$** | **$28$** |
| $y$ | $-10$ | $-3$ | $5$ | $14$ | $24$ |

The coefficients of the plane 

$$
y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 5 \\ 1 & 2 & 9 \\ 1 & 3 & 15 \\ 1 & 4 & 22 \\ 1 & 5 & 28\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ -3 \\ 5 \\ 14 \\ 24\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
